front.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game reward sprite for a language-learning website.
Primary request: Create a Golden Horsey trophy based on Eddie, the friendly horse mascot in the attached reference. This is a sculpted trophy: the ENTIRE Eddie figure must be cast in beautiful gold metal, not a brown horse holding a gold cup.
Input image: the provided Eddie illustration is a character identity and pose reference. Preserve Eddie's swept forelock, big friendly eyes, rounded muzzle, cheerful open smile, upright toy proportions, waving raised hoof, flowing tail, and the small handled star cup he holds.
Materials: rich warm polished gold on body, mane, hooves, tail, eyes and cup, softly brushed gold in broad surfaces, finely cast sculptural detail, warm bronze only in recessed shadow areas. No brown fur, white painted eyes, black hair, or colored enamel.
Stand/platform: Eddie's two feet firmly mounted on an elegant substantial stepped GOLD trophy pedestal, with a softly rounded rectangular lower plinth, narrower upper step, beveled edges and a small blank inset plaque on the front. The pedestal is part of the one trophy asset. It must look collectible and premium but charming.
Composition: single centered full-body trophy, front three-quarter view very close to the reference, slightly above the base so its top is visible, entire raised hoof, ears, tail and stand inside the frame with generous transparent margins. Square canvas. The stand should occupy roughly the bottom 15 percent of the trophy height.
Lighting: warm studio key light from upper left, soft reflections and subtle rim light, realistic dimensional metal, clear silhouette readable as a small map reward.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the trophy, including the gaps between arms and body and around the tail. No painted checkerboard, no white studio backdrop, no room, no floor, no added decor.
Text: none; leave the plaque blank for live lesson labels. No watermark, no extra objects.
front.preparation: Preserved genuine alpha; resized to 720 square with 24px transparent padding; WebP quality 93, alpha quality 100.

map.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a transparent elevated-view map sprite.
Reference 1 (gold Eddie trophy): preserve the exact character identity, waving pose, star cup, gold-metal material, three stepped golden pedestal and blank plaque.
Reference 2 (round seaside platform): CAMERA ANGLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its elevated oblique overhead viewpoint, looking down about 45 degrees toward the horizontal ground, with near-orthographic projection. The round platform top appears as a broad ellipse. Do not include the platform or scenery in the output.
Create a NEW CAMERA VIEW of the reference 1 trophy. Physically move the camera higher and look down at the same upright statue; do not merely shrink, squash or tilt a frontal picture. Clearly show the top of the swept mane, tops of shoulders, the open inside of the held cup, Eddie's hooves from above, and a broad upper surface of the stepped pedestal. The front face and friendly eyes remain recognizable with natural foreshortening. The front plaque is smaller in height from this viewpoint. The gold pedestal should lie on a horizontal ground plane that matches reference 2. Golden sculpted body, gold mane and hooves and tail; realistic warm satin/polished gold, subtle dark bronze cavities, no colored fur or enamel. Lighting from upper left, compact soft contact shadow only under the base.
One centered trophy only, fully visible with comfortable transparent margins. 1024 square composition. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, no black or white backdrop, no checkerboard, no platform, no coastline, no text, no watermark. Keep silhouette clean and readable at small map size.
map.preparation: The angle render and transparency edit contained a baked checkerboard. Built-in editor replaced only the background with solid blue. tools/build-golden-eddie-map.cjs converts that background to alpha and removes blue edge spill, preserving gold/bronze foreground.
